from pathlib import Path
root=Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee')
for rel in ['zcl/cluster/ias_zone_desc.h','zcl/cluster/ias_zone.h']:
    p=root/rel
    print('===',p,'===')
    if not p.exists():
        print('MISSING')
        continue
    ls=p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()
    needles=['server_config','ZONE_TYPE','zone_type','ZONE_STATUS','zone_status','ALARM','ENROLL','status_change','create_cluster_desc','cluster_desc_add_attr','cmd_req','CB_ID']
    shown=set()
    for i,l in enumerate(ls):
        if any(n in l for n in needles):
            lo=max(0,i-5); hi=min(len(ls),i+16)
            if (lo,hi) in shown: continue
            shown.add((lo,hi))
            print('\n'.join(f'{j+1}:{ls[j]}' for j in range(lo,hi)))
print('=== production IAS references ===')
for p in [Path('main'),Path('include'),Path('components')]:
    if not p.exists(): continue
    for f in p.rglob('*'):
        if not f.is_file() or f.suffix not in {'.c','.cc','.cpp','.h','.hpp'}: continue
        text=f.read_text(errors='ignore')
        if any(x in text for x in ['0x0500','IAS_ZONE','ias_zone','ZONE_STATUS','zone_type']):
            print('---',f,'---')
            for i,l in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1):
                if any(x in l for x in ['0x0500','IAS_ZONE','ias_zone','ZONE_STATUS','zone_type']): print(f'{i}:{l}')
